dates.notes: Adopted at the first REAIM Summit in The Hague on 16 February 2023. The Dutch government published the Call to Action and a news item the same day; the closing speech states that more than 60 countries had endorsed it.

gaps: Non-binding political call to action: it creates no legal obligation, ratification, depositary, monitoring, reporting or enforcement.

status_note: Non-binding summit call to action, not a treaty. It was adopted at the first REAIM Summit in The Hague on 16 February 2023. The Dutch government reports more than 60 endorsing countries at the summit; UNIDIR records 58 in its December 2025 chronology. No itemised list is included in this record, and no legal obligation, ratification, depositary, monitoring or enforcement mechanism exists.

checks.result: The four-page PDF sets out a joint call to action on the responsible development, deployment and use of AI in the military domain. It invites governments, industry, knowledge institutions, international organisations and others to support its propositions; it contains no treaty, signature, ratification or entry-into-force clause.

The Dutch government publication page and news item are dated 16 February 2023 and identify the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Defence as responsible, with the Republic of Korea as co-host.

The Dutch closing speech says more than 60 countries had endorsed the Call by 16 February 2023; the news item refers to a country list. No itemised official list was located, and UNIDIR's December 2025 chronology records 58. The record does not assert a precise total.

verification.notes: Metadata verified from the official Dutch publication and news item. The record is metadata-only: no full text is stored. The endorsement total is left unstated because the official and secondary counts differ.
